rules: source_id is the guide's Source ID (C01–C21), so a file always maps back to one guide row.
upload_date is the YouTube upload date (YYYY-MM-DD), not the event date.
uploader_slug is the publishing station/agency, lowercased, ascii, hyphens.
title_slug is the first 60 characters of the upload title, cut on a word boundary.
video_id is the 11-character YouTube id, so a renamed file can always be re-verified.

media_policy.reason: Source video is third-party news/police material with no reuse licence established, and files run to GBs. Downloads live in sources/downloads/ (gitignored); see sources/README.md.
media_policy.rights: No source here is cleared for reuse. YouTube links are locators, not imported files; obtain permission or another lawful basis before publishing.
media_policy.verification: Timestamped storyboard samples + metadata were inspected in the guide's research pass. Continuous picture and source audio were NOT reviewed; all source crops remain approximate.
